title: Verification Compliance Framework — Structure & Enforcement Layer
l2_insight: Verification without criteria is theater — every condition must be precisely testable with grep, file paths, and thresholds
summary: Complete verification compliance framework for Knowledge Metabolism — 5 Condition Pass Criteria (A-E), 3 Verification Tiers, 4-Level Enforcement Ladder (WARNING→FLAG→BLOCK→ESCALATION), audit trail, and explicit Sovereign Mandate compliance (M9, M11, M12, M13).
key_insights: Tiered verification (Critical/Standard/Info) prevents bureaucracy while maintaining integrity
Four-level enforcement ladder gives proportional response before blocking work
Condition D (Soul Integration) is the highest-fidelity evidence of consumption
Any knowledge that cannot be verified as consumed might as well have never been produced
